channel.title: Hoover Sun LLC - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Hoover Sun LLC (hooversun.com)

item.title: Strong roster, high hopes for Jags
item.description: Spain Park softball returns strong senior leaders and rising young talent after a regional run. With college-bound players and deeper experience, the Jaguars aim for consistency and a state tournament push in 2026.

item.title: Authors share paths to writing at Hoover Library’s 2026 Southern Voices Festival
item.description: The Saturday authors conference sold out within 10 minutes of tickets going on sale Jan. 13.

item.title: Hoover events guide: March 2026
item.description: See what's happening in Hoover in March.

item.title: Bucs not shying away from high expectations
item.description: Hoover baseball opens 2026 with high expectations and a talented senior class led by Jaxson Wood and Will Adams. Strong leadership, depth and work ethic fuel the Bucs’ state title hopes.

item.title: Bucs take floor for final four games Thursday
item.description: Hoover's boys and girls basketball teams are headed to the state final four yet again, taking the floor Thursday.

item.title: Bucs leaning on senior hitters, young pitchers
item.description: Hoover softball returns key veterans but must replace standout twins Haley and Lindsey Westhoven. With experienced seniors and young pitchers stepping up, the Bucs aim for another strong Class 7A run.

item.title: Betting for a cure: Pink Palace Casino Night fights breast cancer
item.description: The Breast Cancer Research Foundation of Alabama will host its 18th annual Pink Palace Casino Night on March 7 in Hoover, featuring gaming, music and auctions to fund vital in-state breast cancer research.

item.title: Nick's Notes: March 2026
item.description: Hoover is gaining momentum with Cooper’s Hawk coming to Brock’s Gap and key park upgrades underway, including restored sports complex lighting and a rebuilt Lake House, enhancing jobs, recreation and community life.

item.title: Jags seeking improvement
item.description: Spain Park baseball returns a senior-led, experienced roster aiming for a playoff push in 2026. With depth on the mound and lineup, the Jaguars focus on cleaner play and growth after a rebuilding 2025 season.

item.title: Hoover Public Library to host Kindness Summit volunteer event
item.description: The Hoover Public Library will partner with JustServe to host the Kindness Summit on March 9, connecting residents with volunteer opportunities across the Birmingham area.
